releases.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet

announcement.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
announcement.quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is now available on all Claude plans—including Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise—as well as the Claude Developer Platform, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud's Vertex AI.

releases.notes: The launch post states 'Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-bench Verified' and shows comparison charts for SWE-bench Verified, TAU-bench and a broader benchmark table, but all of these are rendered as images with no extractable text, and the companion system card (anthropic.com/claude-3-7-sonnet-system-card) covers only safety evaluations, not the standard capability benchmarks. No verified numeric score could be sourced within the research budget for this release; left empty rather than guessed. Widely-reported third-party figures (e.g. ~70.3% SWE-bench Verified, ~86.4% MMLU) exist but were not confirmed against Anthropic's own text and are therefore omitted.

announcement.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
announcement.quote: Claude Fable 5 is available everywhere today. Claude Mythos 5 is restricted to Glasswing partners (with cyber safeguards lifted) and soon to select biology researchers (with biology and chemistry safeguards lifted) only, until our broader trusted access program is available.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5

source.note: Table 8.1.A, columns Mythos 5 / Fable 5 / Mythos Preview / Opus 4.8 / GPT-5.2 / Gemini 3.1 Pro; 95 is Fable 5's value (Mythos 5 itself scores 95.5).

releases.notes: Anthropic describes Fable 5 and Mythos 5 as 'the same underlying model' (redeploying-fable-5 post): Fable 5 ships with production safeguards for cybersecurity/biology-chemistry/distillation topics that fall back to Claude Opus 4.8, while Mythos 5 has those safeguards lifted and is restricted to vetted Project Glasswing partners (not a public release, so not recorded as its own entry here). On June 12, 2026 the US government briefly applied export controls to both models, suspending access; access was restored June 30-July 1, 2026 (see the 'Redeploying Claude Fable 5' source). This generation's system card treats GPQA Diamond as saturated and stopped reporting it for Fable 5 specifically (Mythos 5 alone is given at 94.1%, 'averaged over 5 trials'); MMLU/MATH/HumanEval/MMMU are no longer reported for either model, and Terminal-Bench has moved to version 2.1 (not this basket's 2.0), so none of those appear as scores here. Family is recorded as 'Claude Fable' per this project's lineage-fork convention, even though the Opus line (Claude Opus 4.8, and subsequently a further 'Claude Opus 5', per the Fable 5.1 system card's comparison table) continued in parallel rather than being replaced.

releases.notes: Unlike the 5.0 generation, Anthropic's Table 8.1.A for this release reports a single shared column for 'Claude Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1' (the two are explicitly 'the same model, but with different levels of safeguards'), so scores above apply to both; Mythos 5.1 is therefore not recorded as a separate entry. Mythos 5.1 remains restricted to vetted cyberdefense/life-sciences partners via trusted access programs (not public). The same comparison table lists a 'Claude Opus 5' column (system card dated July 24, 2026 per public reporting), confirming the Opus numbered line continued past 4.8 in parallel with the Fable/Mythos lineage; it is not separately researched/recorded in this file given the time budget for this pass. GPQA Diamond, MMLU, MATH and HumanEval are no longer reported by Anthropic for this generation (GPQA was declared saturated as of the Fable 5/Mythos 5 system card); Terminal-Bench has moved to versions 4.0 and 'Science 0.1', neither comparable to this basket's Terminal-Bench 2.0, so no terminal-bench-2 score is recorded.
